# Shared code

One line to a capability of `gate/shared.yaml`: what to use, the package that owns it, and the primitives only the owner reaches. Read it, and the shared module's package at the version `go.mod` pins, before you write a helper.

- lock: use `Lock.Take` of `internal/host/fs` (lock.Take of go-files); outside it the lint refuses syscall.Flock, golang.org/x/sys/unix.Flock.
- digest: use `Hex` of `internal/digest`; outside it the lint refuses crypto/sha256.New, crypto/sha256.Sum256; `internal/journeys` may reach them too: tests.journeys.2: its tests sum on their own.
- atomic-write: use `Writer.Replace` of `internal/host/fs` (write.FileIn of go-files); outside it the lint refuses os.CreateTemp, os.Rename; test files are spared until the test files' raw calls move onto go-files' write helper: test files still make the raw calls the module's helper will take over.
- version: use `Version` of `internal/ordered`.
- archive: use `ReadArchive` of `cmd/gragas-release`; outside it the lint refuses archive/tar, archive/zip, compress; `cmd/gragas-dev` may reach them too: fetch unpacks a pinned tool's download, a gzipped tar or a zip, to the one member it checks; test files are spared until the test files' archive and compress uses go through one helper: test files build tar, zip and gzip archives to feed the readers they test.
- fetch: use `FetchHTTPS` of `cmd/gragas-dev`; outside it the lint refuses net/http; test files are spared until the test files' net/http uses go through one helper: test files serve and fetch from httptest servers.
- walk: use `Tree.List` of `internal/host/fs`; later, until the fourteen product sites that walk call host/fs Tree.List, the lint will refuse path/filepath.WalkDir, io/fs.WalkDir; test files are spared until the fourteen product sites that walk call host/fs Tree.List: test files walk the temp trees they build.
- ordered-yaml: use `ParseStrict` of `internal/ordered`.
- canonical-json: use `Encode` of `internal/canon`.
- marker-splice: use `Splice` of `internal/rendered`; later, until the old engine and migrate are deleted.
- stale-compare: use `Compare` of `internal/rendered`; later, until the old engine and migrate are deleted.
- journal-copy: use `Journal.Keep` of `internal/host/fs`; later, until a go-files tag keeps and restores a file over two roots.
- private-dir: use `Private` of `internal/host/trust` (trust.MkdirPrivate of go-files).
- first-error-writer: use `Speaker` of `internal/dev/say`.
- common-git-dir: use `CommonDir` of `internal/platformgap/goproc/commondir`; later, until go-proc's gitenv gives the common git dir.
